Limited-time offer: under $50 with code OFF50 until February 28. [Get Certified](https://academy.trackforce.com/?utm_medium=Web&utm_source=Web&sfc=701OO00000eq6Lz&utm_campaign=Trackforce%20Academy&utm_term=TT_HC&utm_content=TrackTik_HelpCenter&gclid=®ion=NORAM&) ![Trackforce Academy](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/theming_assets/01KGJ2ZAPA2DET4W33A4QDB69N) ## Browse common questions - Scheduling patrols without adding them to the weekly recurring template Learn how to schedule patrols for one or multiple weeks without adding them to the weekly recurring template. * * * ## Overview Adhoc events are meant to give the Patrol planners more flexibility when they receive none recurrent requests from clients. These events are defined within the template to add or replace recurrent jobs to a specific date in the schedule(live) view. ![AcroRd32_LFbKaPYWj0.png](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/article_attachments/1500005110242) * * * ## Scheduling patrols without adding them to the weekly recurring template To schedule patrols without adding them to your weekly recurring template: 1\. Select the schedule template 2\. Select Price Tier 3\. Select Patrol Type 4\. Select Route Position 5\. Select Time, Min, # frequency 6\. Select Adhoc _Note: You cannot use the “start date” and “end date” fields for Adhoc items._ * * * ## See also - [Using Mobile Suite](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/en-us/sections/6422976924567-Using-Mobile-Suite) - How can I manage my reports with different statuses? > How can I manage my reports with different statuses so myself or someone on my team can approve the reports? When new or existing reports need reviewing or someone else needs to review them, you can utilize the report status to 'tag' the report. Each annotation and change is logged in the report _Comments Log_, so you have a trail of the changes recorded. Also, the _View by_ tab is available. ![Screen_Recording_2021-03-17_at_09.42.15.12_AM.gif](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/article_attachments/1500005147201) **_Operation Reports > Reports > View_** - Mobile App issues with GPS and Checkpoints To ensure you have optimal usage of the GPS and checkpoint features in TrackTik and the TrackTik Guard Tour app, follow these guidelines: - You must have Internet connectivity VIA Wi-Fi or mobile network - You must have a camera for barcode checkpoint support and picture-capturing - Your device must have compatible NFC technology for NFC checkpoint support - Your device must have GPS technology for location services and GPS checkpoint support - Note: Turn location settings and precise location off/on again if you encounter tracking issues, i.e., previously reporting tracks but no longer - If you receive an error message stating 'Unable to Clock In' be sure to check the app's location permissions on your device. - Go to your device settings, find the TrackTik app, and ensure that Location permissions are set to 'Allow all the time'. This should allow the app to access your location and enable clocking in properly. - Ensure you set your device to use the _**network**_ or _**automatic**_ date/time (How to: [Android](https://support.google.com/android/answer/2841106?hl=enhttps://support.google.com/android/answer/2841106?hl=en)/ [iOS](https://support.apple.com/en-ca/guide/iphone/iph65f82af3e/ios)) - Ensure you [accept all permissions](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/en-us/articles/360061856413) when you [install](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/en-us/articles/8057597375255) - Ensure you have good network coverage if on data. See [**this**](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/2651367?hl=en#zippy=%2Cfix-mobile-data-problems) guide - Ensure you have good [**Wi-Fi coverage - i**](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/2651367?hl=en) f you experience a 'server not found' error, try the following troubleshooting steps: - Make sure the device has a stable internet connection, whether through Wi-Fi or mobile data. - Check if the error happens on other devices as well to rule out a device-specific issue. - Verify the version of the app being installed, and ensure it is the latest version available. #### If you encounter a geofence error even though the guard is on site, try the following steps: - Confirm app version and known issues: Check the app version in the app's About or Settings. If it is version 5.14.25 and you use zone-licensed BYOD, uninstall and reinstall from the store to obtain the latest version. That version has known issues for some license types. - Enable high-accuracy location: - Android: Settings > Location > turn on Location; set to High accuracy (use Wi-Fi, Bluetooth scanning). - iOS: Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services > the app > set to Always or While Using the App with Precise Location enabled. - Permission review: Ensure the app has location permission and that background location is allowed if your workflow requires it for geofence validation. - Device settings that affect accuracy: Turn on Wi-Fi even if not connected; it improves positioning. Disable Battery Saver/Optimization for the app. Ensure VPNs or firewall apps are not blocking location services. - Check geofence configuration: Confirm the site geofence is correctly placed and sized. Very small radii can be sensitive; consider modestly increasing the radius for reliability. - Time and sync: Make sure device time is automatic and accurate; incorrect time can affect session validation. Refresh the app or log out/in to force a new location check. - Test and isolate: Try another device at the same site. Try the same device at another site with a known-good geofence. - Escalate with diagnostics: Provide device model, OS, app version, the site, shift details, exact error text, and screenshots of location permissions. If possible, include a map screenshot showing current location relative to the geofence. #### If NFC scans are not appearing on your report sheet, use the following checklist: - Verify the tag and assignment: - Confirm the NFC tag is the correct tag for the location/post and that its UID is registered to the correct site within your configuration. - Ensure the guard is clocking in at the intended site and shift. - If the tag was recently replaced or moved, update the site mapping and test again. - Device and OS compatibility: - iOS: NFC tag reading is supported on most iPhone models from iPhone 7 and newer. If NFC is not supported, the app cannot scan tags. - Android: Ensure the device supports NFC (Settings > Connected devices or Connections > NFC) and that NFC is turned on. - App permissions and settings: - iOS: Allow all requested app permissions. Go to Settings > Privacy & Security > TrackTik and enable Location (preferably Always or While Using the App) and any other requested permissions. If prompted for NFC tag reading, accept the prompt. - Android: Go to Settings > Apps > TrackTik > Permissions and grant Location (set to Precise/High Accuracy), Nearby devices, and any other requested permissions. Also enable NFC in Settings > Connections > NFC and contactless payments. - Correct in-app workflow: - Open the app, navigate to the clock-in screen, choose NFC scan, then hold the device flat against the tag until you see a successful confirmation in the app. Keep the device steady for 1-2 seconds. - Connectivity and offline mode: - If the device is offline when scanning, the clock-in may be stored locally and sent later. Make sure the device has a stable connection, then open the app and manually refresh after reconnecting. - Reporting filters and delays: - Check report filters (date range, site, user) to ensure the scan is included. Allow a short delay for sync and then pull to refresh or reopen the report sheet. - Update or reinstall the app: - Update to the latest app version from the App Store/Google Play. If behavior persists, uninstall and reinstall the app to clear cached data. - Test another device/tag: - Try scanning the same tag with another supported device, and try another known-good tag at the same site to isolate whether the tag or the device is the issue. - Escalate with details: - If scans still do not appear, capture and share: device make/model, OS version, app version, the tag UID, exact time of scan, and screenshots of the in-app confirmation and the report filter settings. This helps support trace server logs and confirm whether scans reached the backend. #### If a patrol appears completed on the device, but checkpoints show as missed or the tour reverts to incomplete These symptoms are typically caused by sync delays, configuration mismatches, or assignment/visibility settings. Use the steps below to diagnose and resolve. **Quick checks** - Verify you are logged into the correct site on the device before scanning. - Confirm the checkpoints you scanned are included in the tour you started. - Ensure the device has a stable data/Wi‑Fi connection while syncing. **Step-by-step troubleshooting** - 1) Check the device’s sync/queue status: - In the mobile app, open the menu and locate Sync, Queue, Pending Uploads, or Outbox. - Tap Sync All and keep the app open until the queue is empty (100% complete). Do not log out while items are pending. - If items are stuck, toggle Airplane Mode off/on, move to better coverage or Wi‑Fi, then retry Sync All. - If the tour appears complete and then reverts to incomplete, capture a screenshot of the synchronization queue showing pending items and timestamps. - 2) Confirm device and app settings: - Enable NFC and/or Camera (depending on checkpoint type) and grant app permissions. - Set Date & time to Automatic; incorrect time can cause ordering/sync issues. - Disable battery optimization for the app so it can sync in the background. - Update the app to the latest version and restart the device. - 3) Validate checkpoint configuration: - In the portal, open the checkpoint and confirm it belongs to the same site you patrolled. - Confirm the scan method (NFC/QR/GPS) matches what was used on the device. - Ensure the checkpoint is Active and included in the intended tour. - Check any role/position restrictions (Assigned to/Visible to). The tour and the guard’s shift must match these restrictions. - 4) Check for duplicates or site mismatches: - The same NFC tag should not exist at multiple sites. If a tag is tied to another site, scans at the current site may fail or not log correctly. - If you moved a tag between sites, reconfigure it at the new site and test again. - 5) Rescan and add context: - If connectivity was poor during the patrol, scans may upload later. Open the app, keep it in the foreground, and let it sync. - If a checkpoint still shows missed, rescan it and add a note to the event with date/time for context. - 6) When to escalate to Support: - Provide a screenshot of the device sync queue, device model and OS version, app version, site name, patrol date/time, and examples of affected checkpoints. #### Can I assign the same NFC tag to multiple sites? Short answer: No. An NFC checkpoint (physical tag) is tied to the specific site where it was created. The same tag cannot be assigned to two different sites at the same time. ##### **Your options** - Use unique NFC tags for each site. Label them clearly to avoid mix-ups. - If you need to move a tag to a new site: remove/unassign it from Site A, then create a new checkpoint in Site B and scan the same physical tag during setup. - If you need a common identifier across sites, consider QR codes or create site-specific tags that share a naming convention rather than reusing the same physical NFC tag. - Where can I find help? In case of permissions or access update requests that TrackTik Support cannot address, consult your internal system administrator for resolution. If platform access is suspended due to administrative issues like outstanding invoices, please resolve these financial obligations promptly to restore access. ## **Contacting Support through the TrackTik Portal** - Look for the **TrackTik Answer Bot** icon in the bottom left-hand corner of your TrackTik Portal. ![](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/article_attachments/34900263744919) - You can start your conversation with the **TrackTik Answer Bot** or select from one of the options. ![2024-09-25_10-34-06.jpg](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/article_attachments/34900290669079) ## Contacting Support from the Help Center From any page on the [TrackTik Help Center](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/en-us), click the **TrackTik Answer Bot** icon in the bottom left-hand corner. ![](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/article_attachments/34900263752343) ## Submitting a request from the Help Center If you are signed into the TrackTik Help Center, you will see the option to **Submit a request** after interacting with the **TrackTik Answer Bot.** Please feel free to submit a support ticket if you can't find what you are looking for through the _Answer Bot_ or _Help Center_. ![](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/article_attachments/34900290673047) ## What to include when submitting a request to TrackTik Technical Support: Providing a clear, complete description of your issue helps Support diagnose and resolve it faster. When you open a ticket or respond to an agent, please include as much as possible. You can use the following to help our team assist you faster: - **Issue summary:** One concise sentence that states the problem (example: "Site information is not populating when selecting a site"). - **Affected area:** Name the module or feature (example: Scheduling, API), and include the page URL or endpoint path if applicable. - **Environment details:** Production or Sandbox; browser and version; operating system; network or VPN context; any recent configuration changes. - **User and account context:** Your organization name, relevant site names/IDs, user role/permissions of the person experiencing the issue. - **Timeframe:** Exact timestamps with time zone when the issue occurred; note whether it is intermittent or consistent. - **Data references:** Reference IDs and labels exactly as seen (site IDs, alarm connection names, customId values). Call out if you notice formatting anomalies (such as trailing spaces) in any identifiers. - **Evidence:** Screenshots or a short screen recording of the behavior with the full browser window visible; copy/paste error text; attach any available logs (for example, relevant error log entries or IDs) if you have access. - **API specifics (if applicable):** Full endpoint, HTTP method, headers (minus secrets), request payload, response status code, and response body. Note validation rules you believe might apply. - **Impact and urgency:** Number of users/sites affected; business impact; deadlines or upcoming events impacted. **Best practices:** - Submit one ticket per distinct issue to avoid conflation and speed up triage. - Use precise language and exact labels/IDs; avoid paraphrasing error messages. - If configuration changed recently (new IDs, renamed alarm connections, permission changes), list those changes. - If the issue is intermittent, describe the pattern (time of day, specific browsers, specific users or sites). If all of the above is not available, please share what you can and our agents will be happy to assist you. ## More resources [![](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/theming_assets/01J4Q4BG4ZENMNDD1WFZC1962R)\\ \\ \\ Developer Tools\\ \\ \\ \\ \\ Data Warehousing, Integrations and API tools.](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/en-us/categories/23505192787223) [![](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/theming_assets/01J4Q4BGKTN4AN9HC3QEF3D0WA)\\ \\ \\ Release Notes\\ \\ \\ \\ \\ Product updates and new features.](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/en-us/categories/6847876795287-Release-notes) [![](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/theming_assets/01J4Q4BGZY9ZS3S0R28KKMRKAX)\\ \\ \\ Policies & resources\\ \\ \\ \\ \\ Company policies, regulatory compliances, and additional user information.](https://support.tracktik.com/hc/en-us/categories/6908948359959-Policies-resources) Can't find what you're looking for?
